title: Room
description: One room in the archive's tree. game/data/rooms.json holds { rooms: Room[] } as a flat list with parent pointers. Array order is door order. Manage it with `npm run archive -- <command>` rather than by hand.

id.description: Stable slug. Never reuse once published.

parent.description: Parent room id. Only the root (kind "void") has null.

title.description: Shown on the door that leads here and on arrival.

kind.description: void = the root threshold; hub = an era's entrance hall (children of the root, in era order); room = a subset of humour (any depth); end = the end of the internet (last child of the root).

era.description: Required on hubs. Rooms inherit it from their nearest ancestor; it sets the room's period look.

blurb.description: One line shown when you arrive.

memes.description: Meme ids exhibited here, in walking order. Every meme lives in exactly one room.
